title: dual-verdict.v1 — bob-persisted INTEGRATED->VERIFIED archive
description: Frozen envelope for the dual-arm verdict archive bob writes to .ledger/verdicts/<bundle_hash>.verdict.yaml before any INTEGRATED -> VERIFIED transition (S044 / #118, design §10 B4). claims.assert_verified_preconditions (R6) READS this archive and refuses the transition unless: schema_version == 'dual-verdict.v1', all cross-binding fields present, BOTH arms present at the ASYMMETRIC canonical keys (audit_arm.result vs arbiter_arm.verdict), and BOTH arms in the closed pass-set {VERIFIED, VERIFIED_WITH_CONCERNS} with neither AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE/REJECTED. HONEST SCOPE: bob writes this archive, so a complete fabricated archive is NOT defended against here (that needs the deferred spawner non-bob-provenance, design §10 B2/B7). R6 catches rationalized/accidental skips, arbiter-only archives, AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE-ignored, unversioned envelopes, and cross-binding mismatch — the observed #43-dev3 drift class.

schema_version.description: Envelope version. R6 rejects any value other than this const (reject unversioned/ambiguous — C6 schema-drift).

component_id.description: Cross-binding: the component this verdict belongs to. Validated TOGETHER with the other cross-binding fields by R6.

bundle_hash.description: Cross-binding: sha256 of the frozen evidence bundle. MUST equal the verdict filename stem (self-binding); R6 enforces archive.bundle_hash == lookup key.

verification_request_id.description: Cross-binding: the open verification request id (claims.open_verification_request). Binds this archive to ONE verification attempt.

prior_state_version.description: Cross-binding: the ledger state version at request time. A stale prior_state_version mismatches R6's expected and is refused.

generation.description: Cross-binding: the component generation at verification time (CB1). Bound TOGETHER so a verdict from generation N cannot satisfy a transition at generation N+1.

audit_arm.description: The metacognitive audit arm (audit_spawn.py, Claude+Codex). CANONICAL axis key is `result` (asymmetric vs the arbiter arm's `verdict`). R6 reads `audit_arm.result` ONLY; it MUST NOT substring-grep the file for AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE (which can legitimately appear in a free-text rerun-history field while the canonical result is REJECTED — the S039 mis-bucketing fixture).

result.description: Canonical audit-arm axis. Pass-set = {VERIFIED, VERIFIED_WITH_CONCERNS}. REJECTED/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE are explicit non-pass; R6 fails closed.

claude_verdict.description: DECOY sub-vocabulary (intra-audit Claude arm: pass/pass_with_concerns/fail). R6 MUST NOT read this — it is NOT the canonical axis.

codex_verdict.description: DECOY sub-vocabulary (intra-audit Codex arm). R6 MUST NOT read this.

arbiter_arm.description: The verification-arbiter arm (verification_arbiter_spawn.py, single cold-context Claude). CANONICAL axis key is `verdict` (asymmetric vs the audit arm's `result`). The 8-field tuple lives here per design §10 B4.

verdict.description: Canonical arbiter-arm axis. Same pass-set + fail-set semantics as audit_arm.result.

combined_outcome.description: Bob's human-readable summary of the combined gate (advisory; R6 derives its own verdict from the two canonical arm keys, NOT from this field).

rerun_notes.description: Optional free-text rerun history. May contain a misleading first_run_result: AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE string — R6 IGNORES this and reads only the canonical audit_arm.result (S039 asymmetric-key fixture).
